name: Advance Cyberdark Horn
desc: You can target 1 Dragon or Machine monster in either GY; Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, and if you do, equip that monster to this card. This card gains ATK equal to the equipped Monster Card's ATK. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Cyberdark" card from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Advance Cyberdark Horn" once per turn.
strings: Special Summon this card and equip
Send 1 "Cyberdark" card from Deck to GY
